description: This file is a test suite for the ModuleDao class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for the admin plugin. It contains unit tests that verify the functionality of fetching and updating module statuses in the system.

classes.name: ModuleDaoTest
classes.description: A unit test class for the ModuleDao data access object, testing module listing, status updates, and retrieval of disabled modules.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ModuleDao instance and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetModuleList
methods.description: Verifies that the getModuleList method returns the correct number of Module objects and their properties.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatus
methods.description: Tests updating the status of modules and verifies the change persisted correctly.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatusForReturnedValues
methods.description: Ensures that the method returns the updated Module objects with correct statuses.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatusWithModulesDoesNotExists
methods.description: Checks behavior when updating status for modules that may not exist, ensuring the list remains consistent and excludes non-existing modules.

methods.name: testDisabledModuleList
methods.description: Asserts that the getDisabledModuleList method correctly identifies disabled modules.
